record.context_brief: Stability of strict GKK and strict GKK τ-matrices
record.original_question: Suppose A is a strict GKK matrix, meaning that A is a P-matrix and A[α, β]A[β, α] > 0 for every almost principal minor. Must A be stable, in the sense that all eigenvalues of A have positive real part? More specifically, if A is also a τ-matrix, meaning that A satisfies eigenvalue monotonicity l(A(α, α)) ≤ l(A(β, β)) < ∞ whenever ∅ ≠ β ⊆ α and also l(A) ≥ 0, must A be stable?

evidence.quote: A matrix A is called an ω-matrix [5] if it has eigenvalue monotonicity in the sense that l(A(α, α)) ≤ l(A(β, β)) < ∞ whenever ∅ 6= β ⊆ α ∈ hni. A is a τ -matrix if, in addition, l(A) ≥ 0. A matrix is called positive stable if its spectrum lies entirely in the open right half plane. In the sequel, we will shorten the term ‘positive stable’ to simply ‘stable’.
1a. Strict GKK matrices: stability. Are strict GKK matrices stable? Are strict GKK τ -matrices stable?

artifact.status_search_result: Holtz constructed Toeplitz Hessenberg matrices that are GKK τ-matrices but not stable, thereby disproving Hershkowitz's and related conjectures for general (not strict) GKK τ-matrices. However, these counterexample matrices are explicitly not strict GKK, so the stability question for strict GKK matrices and strict GKK τ-matrices appears to remain open in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Not all GKK τ-matrices are stable
status_evidence.snippet: Holtz exhibits a family of GKK τ-matrices that are not stable, disproving the conjectures of Carlson, Engel–Schneider, Varga and Hershkowitz.
status_evidence.claim: General GKK τ-matrices need not be stable, but the counterexamples are not strict GKK.

status_evidence.title: Theorems and counterexamples on structured matrices
status_evidence.snippet: The matrices A_{n,k,t} are GKK and τ-matrices for suitable parameters; they are noted as not strict GKK.
status_evidence.claim: Known unstable GKK τ-matrices fail to be strict GKK, leaving the strict case open.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on GKK τ-matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Lists as open problem 1a: Are strict GKK matrices stable? Are strict GKK τ-matrices stable?
status_evidence.claim: The strict GKK stability question is posed as open.
